_note: v2.4 plan 02 follow-ups E5 + E5 completion live gate (00-overview Decisions E5; 02 gate record 'Follow-ups E2-E5' and 'E3/E5 completion' NOT done lists). No model call. Run: node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts batch --lanes 1 --repeat 2 --strict --group 1759606632088 test/scenarios/live-v24-02-e5-startup-unbind.json. The page has to LAND on a chat by loading, not by a switch, so ST's power_user.auto_load_chat is switched on for the run (RossAscends-mods.js:697 RA_autoloadchat -> openGroupById(active_group) opens group.chat_id) and put back in the last step; the reload step waits for ST to open the chat itself (reload.awaitChatMs, reopenChat false). Parent A plays two consumed lines (line 0 with a relationship memory, so A's mirror book is bound to its chat lorebook slot). /branch-create 0 opens branch B; the switch unbind is checked (pre-E5 behaviour), then B's slot is set back to A's book on disk, which is the state ST's createBranch writes (bookmarks.js:199-201 + group-chats.js:2370). (1) Reload onto the unadopted branch: the slot is unbound in memory and on disk, the branch notice (#so-branch-notice) shows, and our blob on disk is byte-identical to before the reload (still stamped for A). (2) Control: Continue from here, sync, B binds its own book; reload onto the adopted B keeps it. (3) Control: open A, reload onto A keeps A's book. (4) E5 completion on A after that reload: /persona-sync (a same-chat reloadCurrentChat, H9) keeps the session epoch and rolls nothing back, and a switch to B afterwards still bumps the epoch. sessionStorage carries the run's state across reloads.
